summary: Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 12, 2026, its routine quarterly foreign-private-issuer report. Revenue was $161.7 million, up 18% sequentially and 26% year over year; gross margin was 7.9%; operating profit $3.5 million; net income $1.2 million; EPS $0.03 on 41,232,454 weighted average shares following February 2026 share issuance. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings disclosure with no special-situations angle; watch only operating margin and copper-price working-capital sensitivity.
